end.summary:
Fractions on a number line were introduced using equal gaps and points.
Riya identified that five equal gaps make the first point 1/5.
Riya connected the midpoint of 0 and 1 with 1/2.
Riya remained unsure about the point between 1/2 and 1; teach-back was not passed.
Riya requested picture-based explanations and geometry examples.
end.parentNote: Asha practised placing fractions on a number line by dividing the interval into equal parts. Riya connected the midpoint with 1/2 and identified the first of five equal gaps as 1/5. They mixed up gaps and points when discussing the point between 1/2 and 1; this was not corrected by the end. At home, draw a 0–1 line divided into four equal parts and label each point together, using a picture.
